game_title: Condition Builder – Dragon Hoard Cave Defense
game_concept: A survival strategy set in Shadow Cave – Dragon Hoard Cave, a hoard-filled cave: the dwarf scout must handle rock golems while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Condition Builder: Choose the loop condition so the loop runs exactly the requested number of times.
theme: Shadow Cave – Dragon Hoard Cave: a hoard-filled cave
core_gameplay_loop: In Dragon Hoard Cave, repeat each round: Choose the loop condition so the loop runs exactly the requested number of times. Each round, rock golems strike the crystal door, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the loop_runs value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the crystal door from rock golems in Dragon Hoard Cave: keep the loop_runs meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 39-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: loop_runs drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 39-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 4 (applied tier): Condition Builder
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how loop_runs changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rock golems in Dragon Hoard Cave.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 39 seconds while loop_runs > 0.
